title: Manual Campaign Import Schema
description: Template for Mike to manually paste authenticated Vyro/Whop campaign data extracted from logged-in dashboard sessions. Tess will parse this structure to build CPM filtering logic against real campaign parameters instead of hallucinating scraped placeholders.

importTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when Mike exported this data from authenticated dashboard session.

campaigns.description: Array of active campaign objects extracted from authenticated dashboard.

title.description: Campaign display name (e.g., 'ABC: Scrubs // Humorous Clips Only').

cpmRate.description: CPM rate in USD (e.g., '$2.00', '$2.50'). Tess will parse this for net yield scoring.

flatFeeBonus.description: Optional flat-fee scalp bonus in USD (e.g., 1.50 for Whop instant-approval clips). Default: 0.

viewFloor.description: Minimum view threshold to qualify for payout (e.g., '1000', '5000').

poolStatus.description: Campaign pool status string (e.g., 'ACTIVE // 88% Pool Left (~14 Days)', 'LOCKED FOR NEW POSTS', 'ENDED').

runwayDays.description: Estimated days remaining before pool depletion (e.g., 14, 10, 0 for dry campaigns).

dailyPostCap.description: Maximum posts allowed per day per creator (e.g., 5). Default: 5.

hookHeadline.description: Suggested viral hook headline for clip overlay (e.g., 'THIS SCRUBS SCENE BROKE CHARACTER').

campaignUrl.description: Optional direct URL to campaign dashboard page (if available).

notes.description: Optional operational notes (e.g., 'Requires manual approval', 'Auto-approved within 24h').

campaigns.title: ABC: Scrubs // Humorous Clips Only
campaigns.notes: Auto-approved within 48 hours if view floor met.
